card.name: Just before an L in brand names
card.fires_on: A piece of a brand name or abbreviation right before the letters L, LL or LSA, such as NER|LYNX, CAPRE|LSA, and PT|LD. It also fires on the d in mg/dL or ng/dL just before the L.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens that start with l or ll, so it probably stops the model from predicting a second L right after one has already been written.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside a drug brand name or unit like mg/dL where the next letter is an L.
